# Osinty: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code b051a11b4e35 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Learn open-source intelligence (OSINT) the way private investigators use it: 24 lessons, realistic fictional case files, a field kit of tools and your own casebook.
**Live:** https://osinty.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/osinty · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `osinty/.claude/skills/osinty/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py osinty` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Branch `forms`** (Nov 2026) is the Forms rebuild; master/live still runs the old JS-pages build until it's merged.
- **List vs detail Forms:** router `_form(name, args)` opens a different Form when the address names an item:
  `#academy` Academy / `#academy/<id>` Lesson, `#cases` Cases / `#cases/<id>` CaseDesk, `#casebook` Casebook /
  `#casebook/<id>/<tab>` Investigation (tabs are addresses, so a tab click reloads the page), `#kit/<gadget>` = the Kit
  page with a `Gadgets/*` Form added to `gadget_holder`.
- **Items reach their page through `item["host"]`** (CaseDesk: DocCard pin, Exhibit/`code` pivot, CaseQuestion
  answer/hint; Investigation: LeadRow, LinkRow, CheckRow; Kit: ToolCard star, ChipButton). Simpler than events.
- **JS engines** (theme/assets/os-kit.js, `window.OS`): corkboard (`OS.board`, wrapped by Components/Corkboard; data
  goes in as JSON so the engine can move pins in place; `leave()` destroys it), EXIF reader (`OS.exif` -> JSON),
  rank shield SVG, `+XP` stamp, `OS.fold` (accent folding for the gadgets: Skulpt has no unicodedata). Everything
  else is Python: os_kit.py (Markdown `md()`, `celebrate()` + Dialogs/Promotion), gadget_kit.py (gadget logic).
- **Tool ids** in os_data.TOOLS/GADGETS are named by lessons; test_server.py greps `"id": "..."` in os_data.py.
- **Office radio** (Shell): ArkMusic tracks, off by default, stored in `osinty.radio`, never on #admin.
  APP_MAKER/tools/music_sync.py still points at the old folder's _arkmusic.html: after merging, point it at
  `osinty-forms/theme/assets/ark-music.js` ("file").
- **Markdown in content** (lessons, case docs, debrief) goes through `os_kit.md()` (escapes first) into dom nodes.
- Report tables are CSS grids with ARIA table roles (RepeatingPanels can't live inside `<table>`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **bulletins**: title:str, body:str, kind:str, author→users, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, DemoData
- **case_runs**: user→users, case_id:str, found:obj, pinned:obj, answers:obj, hints:obj, wrong:num, searches:num, status:str, score:num, xp:num, started:dt, updated:dt, finished:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, Cases, DemoData
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **investigations**: owner→users, title:str, subject:str, objective:str, status:str, checklist:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, Casebook
- **leads**: investigation→investigations, kind:str, value:str, note:str, source:str, grade:str, when:str, x:num, y:num, created:dt · used in Agents, Casebook
- **links**: investigation→investigations, a→leads, b→leads, label:str, created:dt · used in Agents, Casebook
- **progress**: user→users, lesson_id:str, module_id:str, score:num, total:num, xp:num, completed:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Academy, Admin, Agents, DemoData
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, xp:num, streak:num, active_day:date, board_hidden:bool, kit:obj, briefing_day:date · used in Admin, Agents, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
